subject.title: fix(memory-core): keep same-agent session hits in memory recall under tree visibility (#103732)

question: Should unset `tools.sessions.visibility` intentionally expose unrelated same-agent transcripts through memory recall even though explicit `tree`, direct session history, sibling memory surfaces, and current documentation retain the current-session-tree boundary?
rationale: This is a deliberate authorization-policy change, not a source-level ambiguity; only the feature owners can approve a broader implicit default and its compatibility consequences.

options.title: Preserve current contract
options.body: Keep default `tree` scoped to the current session tree and require the existing `visibility: "agent"` opt-in for unrelated same-agent recall.

options.title: Approve broader implicit recall
options.body: Sponsor a shared contract change across memory-core, memory-wiki, session tools, documentation, SDK policy, and upgrade/security proof.

recommendation.title: Preserve current contract
recommendation.body: Keep default `tree` scoped to the current session tree and require the existing `visibility: "agent"` opt-in for unrelated same-agent recall.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the merged feature that established the affected memory-search visibility contract.
